comment: The Go CLI's inventory (internal docs/design/go-cli.md, decision 16): every command, option and environment variable of the TypeScript CLI, kept equal to its source both ways by apps/cli/test/cli-inventory.test.ts, and what must be covered once its slice is built, checked by go/cmd/varlatch's TestInventoryCoverage. Edited by hand; the test says what is missing.

ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL.note: OIDC sign-in from GitHub Actions, with ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN

AI_AGENT.note: a coding agent's marker: assisted mode, unless VARLATCH_ASSISTED turns detection off

GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL.note: scan --find-files: Git's global configuration, for core.excludesFile

HOME.note: the home directory as Node's os.homedir() finds it, an empty value counting as unset (@varlatch/context homeDirectory, which scan --find-files uses too); the guardrail hook reads it too

HTTP_PROXY.note: set for the Agent by an agent-safe run, read by varlatch request

NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY.note: set for the Agent by an agent-safe run, so a Node.js Agent uses the proxy

OPENCODE.note: a coding agent's marker: assisted mode, unless VARLATCH_ASSISTED turns detection off

VARLATCH_AGENT_RUN.note: set inside an agent-safe run: the operator's store is never read or written

VARLATCH_ASSISTED.note: assisted mode: 1 or true on, 0 or false off and marker detection off

VARLATCH_BROKER_CREDENTIAL.note: the agent-safe run's proxy credential, read by varlatch request

VARLATCH_ENV.note: the Environment: --environment/-e > VARLATCH_ENV > the local selection > the committed default

VARLATCH_MCP_ALLOW_DISCLOSE.note: varlatch mcp: refused when set to anything but empty or 0

VARLATCH_NODE_CHECK.note: the Node.js version warning; no Node.js in Go. The recorder sets it to off

VARLATCH_NO_BROWSER.note: browser sign-in prints the address instead of opening a browser

VARLATCH_OIDC_TOKEN.note: OIDC sign-in: --oidc-token > VARLATCH_OIDC_TOKEN > the GitHub Actions endpoint

VARLATCH_RUN_CONTEXT.note: given to the command by run --export-context

VARLATCH_SERVER.note: the server: --server > VARLATCH_SERVER > the local override > varlatch.toml > the default server > the only stored credential

VARLATCH_SYNC_TOKEN.note: sync push and sync check: the platform credential when --token-env is not given; no other fallback

VARLATCH_TOKEN.note: the credential: VARLATCH_TOKEN > the stored credential; also masked in a server's text

XDG_CONFIG_HOME.note: see VARLATCH_CONFIG_DIR; scan --find-files also reads Git's ignore file under it

precedence.name: credential
steps: the stored credential for the server

precedence.name: oidc-token
steps: the GitHub Actions endpoint (ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL with ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN)

precedence.name: assisted
steps: an agent marker, in AgentMarkers order

precedence.name: sync-token
steps: none: the error (no GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN fallback)

exits.meaning: the server cannot be reached or is in maintenance
login --wait: still pending at its deadline
an approval still pending (assisted) or expired
Ctrl-C stopped the wait for an approval
incomplete: items this identity may not read
strict violation, or assisted mode cannot mask a Secret
run passes the started command's status through (128 plus a signal's number)
findings, and every failure (usage, authentication, network)
the Broker refuses or the response is cut off
